taiwan_news.title: 世界骨鬆日：健保給付骨密度檢查與擴大骨鬆用藥，停經婦女、糖尿病與長期類固醇者受惠
taiwan_news.summary: 健保署指出台灣約每3名女性、每5名男性就有1人骨鬆，骨折後再骨折率可達50%。健保給付50歲以上、停經婦女、非外傷骨折等高風險者DXA骨密度檢查（至少間隔2年、終身3次）；2026年8月起romosozumab放寬為停經後高骨折風險婦女第一、二線用藥，合併糖尿病或長期類固醇者也納入初級預防給付。

taiwan_news.title: 台北慈濟與台大團隊發現：塑化劑DEHP使肝臟多產尿毒素、腎臟少排出，腎友負擔加重
taiwan_news.summary: 台北慈濟醫院血液透析中心主任郭克林與台大醫學院團隊研究刊登於《Journal of Hazardous Materials Advances》：DEHP可能增加肝臟生成尿毒素硫酸吲哚酚並降低腎臟清除力。小鼠暴露後肌酸酐、尿素氮上升、腎纖維化加重；395名透析病人中DEHP濃度較高者尿毒素也較高。建議熱食與油膩食物改用玻璃或不鏽鋼容器。

taiwan_news.title: 肯亞、奈及利亞出現境外移入伊波拉病例，剛果疫情致死率48%，疾管署維持第三級旅遊警示
taiwan_news.summary: 疾管署10月21日指出，奈及利亞與肯亞各通報首例境外移入布迪布焦伊波拉病例，肯亞已累計9例皆為已知接觸者。剛果民主共和國主要疫情截至10月18日確診9,552例、死亡4,602例，致死率48.2%，擴及8省66個衛生區。疾管署評估對台威脅低，暫不調整肯亞與奈國旅遊警示，剛果維持第三級警告。

taiwan_news.title: 肛門口摸到硬塊、熬夜就腫痛？25歲男子確診肛門瘻管，醫：藥物無法根治需手術
taiwan_news.summary: 大腸直腸外科醫師何建霖說明，肛門瘻管多起於肛門腺體感染形成膿瘍，破裂或引流後約30至50%會留下瘻管，好發於年輕至中年男性，糖尿病與免疫力低下者風險較高。症狀為反覆腫痛、流膿；需依瘻管深度選擇切開、切除或保留括約肌手術，肛門不適應及早至大腸直腸外科就診。

taiwan_news.title: 過了40歲吃一樣多卻變胖？腸胃科醫師解析中年4大變化：量腰圍比量體重更重要
taiwan_news.summary: 新光醫院胃腸肝膽科張璨璿醫師指出，中年後身體容忍度下降，多吃一點就脹氣、宵夜易逆流；壓力與應酬讓體重上升；基礎代謝率下降、肌肉流失形成腹部脂肪並增加逆流風險；咖啡因與酒精耐受度也改變。建議吃七八分飽、睡前2至3小時不進食、每週150分鐘中等強度有氧加阻力訓練、定期量腰圍。
taiwan_news.topic: 中年代謝變化腹部肥胖

nejm.title: Retatrutide Once Weekly for Treatment of Obstructive Sleep Apnea.
nejm.title_zh: 每週一次Retatrutide治療阻塞型睡眠呼吸中止症（TRIUMPH-1/2-OSA）
nejm.abstract: Two phase 3 placebo-controlled trials enrolled adults with moderate-to-severe OSA and BMI ≥27, without (n=243) or with (n=448) type 2 diabetes, randomized to weekly retatrutide 4, 9 or 12 mg or placebo. At 80 weeks the apnea-hypopnea index fell by up to 34.3 events/hour versus 9.9 with placebo, and body weight fell 12–22% versus about 5%. Gastrointestinal events were the most common adverse effects.
nejm.abstract_zh: 兩項第3期安慰劑對照試驗納入中重度OSA且BMI≥27的成人（無糖尿病243人、合併第2型糖尿病448人），每週注射三重促效劑retatrutide 4、9或12 mg或安慰劑。第80週呼吸中止低通氣指數最多下降34.3次/小時（安慰劑9.9），體重減少12–22%（安慰劑約5%）。最常見副作用為腸胃道症狀。

nejm.title: Tambotatug Pelitecan in Small-Cell Lung Cancer after Platinum-Based Therapy.
nejm.title_zh: B7-H3抗體藥物複合體用於鉑類治療後小細胞肺癌之第三期試驗（TAISHAN-302）
nejm.abstract: In a phase 3 open-label trial, 451 patients with small-cell lung cancer progressing after platinum therapy received the B7-H3-targeting antibody-drug conjugate tambotatug pelitecan or topotecan. Median overall survival was 13.3 versus 9.4 months (HR 0.46), progression-free survival 7.4 versus 2.8 months (HR 0.29) and objective response 59.1% versus 9.7%, with fewer grade ≥3 adverse events (55.4% vs 77.9%).
nejm.abstract_zh: 第3期開放標籤試驗納入451名鉑類治療後惡化的小細胞肺癌病人，隨機接受B7-H3標靶抗體藥物複合體tambotatug pelitecan或topotecan。中位整體存活13.3對9.4個月（HR 0.46），無惡化存活7.4對2.8個月（HR 0.29），客觀反應率59.1%對9.7%，≥3級不良事件反而較少（55.4%對77.9%）。

nejm.title: Response-Tailored or Standard-Duration Antibiotic Treatment for Infective Endocarditis.
nejm.title_zh: 感染性心內膜炎依臨床反應縮短抗生素療程與標準療程之比較（POET II）
nejm.abstract: In this international open-label trial, 508 clinically stable patients with left-sided infective endocarditis who had completed 2–4 weeks of antibiotics were randomized to stop or to continue to 4–6 weeks. Days alive without antibiotics were 183 versus 169 (P<0.001); the safety composite occurred in 8.2% versus 10.7% (noninferior), but relapse was more frequent with the shortened strategy (5.1% vs 1.6%, P=0.04).
nejm.abstract_zh: 國際開放標籤試驗納入508名已完成2–4週抗生素且臨床穩定的左心感染性心內膜炎病人，隨機分配為依反應停藥或續用至4–6週。無抗生素存活天數183對169天（P<0.001）；安全性複合終點8.2%對10.7%達非劣性，但縮短療程組復發率較高（5.1%對1.6%，P=0.04）。

lancet.title: Disease-free survival and overall survival after neoadjuvant immunotherapy in mismatch repair-deficient colon cancer in the Netherlands: results of the single-arm, multicentre, phase 2, NICHE-2 trial.
lancet.title_zh: dMMR大腸癌術前免疫治療之3年無病存活與5年整體存活（NICHE-2）
lancet.abstract: In the single-arm phase 2 NICHE-2 trial, 111 patients with resectable stage 2–3 mismatch repair-deficient colon cancer received one dose of ipilimumab and two doses of nivolumab before surgery. At a median postoperative follow-up of 58.7 months, 3-year disease-free survival and 5-year overall survival were both 100%. ctDNA cleared in 82% before surgery and all patients were ctDNA-negative afterward, supporting neoadjuvant immunotherapy as a potential standard of care.
lancet.abstract_zh: 單臂第2期NICHE-2試驗納入111名可切除第2–3期錯配修復缺陷（dMMR）大腸癌病人，術前給予1劑ipilimumab加2劑nivolumab。術後中位追蹤58.7個月，3年無病存活率與5年整體存活率皆達100%；術前ctDNA清除率82%，術後全數ctDNA陰性，支持術前免疫治療成為dMMR大腸癌的潛在標準治療。

lancet.title: 8 weeks versus 12 weeks of sofosbuvir-velpatasvir for treatment-naive, non-cirrhotic, chronic hepatitis C (RESOLVE): a multicentre, open-label, non-inferiority, randomised controlled trial in India.
lancet.title_zh: 無肝硬化C型肝炎sofosbuvir-velpatasvir 8週與12週療程之非劣性試驗（RESOLVE）
lancet.abstract: In this open-label non-inferiority RCT at five public hospitals in India, 880 treatment-naive adults with non-cirrhotic chronic HCV were randomized to 8 or 12 weeks of sofosbuvir-velpatasvir. Per-protocol SVR12 was 98.8% with 8 weeks versus 99.0% with 12 weeks (difference 0.2%, 95% CI −1.5 to 1.9); intention-to-treat 93.5% versus 91.8%. No drug-related serious adverse events occurred, supporting a shorter regimen in this population.
lancet.abstract_zh: 印度5家公立醫院開放標籤非劣性RCT，880名未曾治療、無肝硬化的慢性C肝成人隨機接受sofosbuvir-velpatasvir 8週或12週。依計畫書SVR12為98.8%對99.0%（差0.2%，95% CI −1.5至1.9），意向治療93.5%對91.8%，無藥物相關嚴重不良事件，支持此族群縮短療程至8週。

jama.title: Obesity in Children Aged 2 to 12 Years: A Review.
jama.abstract: Obesity affects 15% of US children aged 2–5 and 22% aged 6–11 and is linked to dyslipidemia, hypertension, MASLD and sleep apnea; affected children are 5 times more likely to have obesity as adults. First-line care is intensive health behavior and lifestyle treatment (≥26 contact hours over 3–12 months, lowering BMI by 0.7). Setmelanotide is the only FDA-approved drug under age 12; liraglutide reduced BMI by 7.4% in a trial of children aged 6–11.
jama.abstract_zh: 美國2–5歲兒童肥胖率15%、6–11歲22%，與血脂異常、高血壓、MASLD及睡眠呼吸中止相關，成年後肥胖風險高5倍。第一線為密集行為與生活型態治療（3–12個月至少26小時，BMI約降0.7）。12歲以下唯一FDA核准藥物為setmelanotide（罕見單基因肥胖）；liraglutide在6–11歲試驗中使BMI降7.4%。

jama.title: Initial HIV Therapy for Adults and Treatment-Associated Weight Gain: The Opti-DOR Randomized Clinical Trial.
jama.title_zh: HIV初始治療與體重增加：Doravirine/TDF與Dolutegravir/TAF之比較（Opti-DOR）
jama.abstract: This open-label noninferiority RCT randomized 600 treatment-naive adults in South Africa to doravirine/lamivudine/tenofovir disoproxil fumarate or dolutegravir/emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide. Week-48 viral suppression was 89.0% versus 90.7% (noninferior). Median weight gain was 3.0 versus 5.0 kg (difference −2.0 kg, P<0.001), but bone mineral density losses were larger and doravirine resistance emerged in 7 of 9 virologic failures.
jama.abstract_zh: 南非600名未曾治療的HIV成人開放標籤非劣性RCT，比較doravirine/lamivudine/TDF與dolutegravir/emtricitabine/TAF。第48週病毒抑制率89.0%對90.7%達非劣性；中位體重增加3.0對5.0 kg（差−2.0 kg，P<0.001），但骨密度流失較多，9例病毒學失敗中7例出現doravirine抗藥性。

jama.title: Oxygen vs Air at Birth for Moderate- to Late-Preterm Infants: The AIROPLANE Cluster Randomized Crossover Trial.
jama.title_zh: 中晚期早產兒出生急救初始氧濃度30%與21%之比較（AIROPLANE）
jama.abstract: In a cluster randomized crossover trial across 26 Australian hospitals, 1818 neonates born at 32–35 weeks who needed respiratory support within 3 minutes of birth received initial FiO2 0.30 or 0.21. Ongoing respiratory support on leaving the delivery room occurred in 72.6% versus 73.3% (risk difference −0.83, 95% CI −4.33 to 2.67). FiO2 0.30 was associated with less escalation of support and fewer later endotracheal ventilations.
jama.abstract_zh: 澳洲26家醫院叢集隨機交叉試驗納入1818名32–35週、出生3分鐘內需呼吸支持的早產兒，比較初始FiO2 0.30與0.21。離開產房時仍需呼吸支持者72.6%對73.3%（風險差−0.83，95% CI −4.33至2.67）無差異；0.30組產房內升級支持與後續插管較少。

jama.title: Individualized Cardiac Index-Guided Hemodynamic Therapy in High-Risk Patients Undergoing Elective Major Abdominal Surgery: The PELICAN Randomized Clinical Trial.
jama.title_zh: 高風險腹部大手術個人化心指數導向血流動力治療（PELICAN）
jama.abstract: In this multicenter single-blind RCT at 12 European centers, 1095 high-risk patients undergoing elective major abdominal surgery were randomized to cardiac index-guided hemodynamic therapy targeting their preoperative resting cardiac index or routine therapy. The 7-day composite of acute kidney injury, myocardial injury, severe infection, cardiac arrest or death occurred in 44.3% versus 46.9% (RR 0.94, P=0.38), with no difference in any component.
jama.abstract_zh: 歐洲12家醫學中心單盲RCT納入1095名高風險擇期腹部大手術病人，隨機分配至以術前靜息心指數為目標的個人化血流動力治療或常規治療。術後7天內急性腎損傷、心肌損傷、嚴重感染、心跳停止或死亡的複合終點為44.3%對46.9%（RR 0.94，P=0.38），各分項亦無差異。

gastro.title: Microbiota-Taurine Pathway Links Dietary Fiber to Mucosal Healing.
gastro.title_zh: 膳食纖維經腸道菌－牛磺酸路徑促進黏膜癒合：動物機轉與潰瘍性結腸炎隨機試驗
gastro.abstract: Alginate fiber improved recovery from DSS colitis in mice by enriching taurine-releasing bacteria, raising intestinal taurine and inducing epithelial Cyp2c55; the benefit disappeared with antibiotics or in Slc6a6−/− and Cyp2c55−/− mice. In a randomized placebo-controlled trial of ulcerative colitis patients after antibiotic-primed fecal microbiota transplantation, alginate did not meet the primary endpoint but increased fecal taurine and colonic CYP2C18 expression, consistent with the proposed mechanism.
gastro.abstract_zh: 海藻酸鹽纖維可富集釋放牛磺酸的腸道菌、提高腸道牛磺酸並誘導上皮Cyp2c55，促進小鼠DSS結腸炎恢復；給予抗生素或剔除Slc6a6、Cyp2c55基因後效果消失。潰瘍性結腸炎病人在抗生素前處理糞菌移植後補充海藻酸鹽的隨機安慰劑對照試驗未達主要終點，但糞便牛磺酸與結腸CYP2C18表現上升，與機轉一致。

gastro.title: β-Glucan and Inulin Estimated Intake Are Associated With Reduced Risk of Crohn's Disease, Improved Gut Barrier and Systemic Inflammation Markers, and Multi-Omic Signatures in a High-Risk Cohort.
gastro.title_zh: β-葡聚醣與菊糖攝取與克隆氏症風險降低相關：高風險一等親世代研究
gastro.abstract: In the GEM Project, 3314 asymptomatic first-degree relatives of Crohn's disease patients were followed for a median 8.5 years and 94 developed CD. Higher estimated β-glucan (HR 0.70) and inulin (HR 0.68) intake were associated with lower CD risk, lower lactulose-mannitol ratio, fewer pathobionts and lower CRP, TREM-1, oncostatin M and MMP-9, supporting microbiome-informed dietary prevention trials.
gastro.abstract_zh: GEM計畫追蹤3314名克隆氏症病人的無症狀一等親，中位8.5年有94人發病。估計β-葡聚醣（HR 0.70）與菊糖（HR 0.68）攝取較高者克隆氏症風險較低，腸道通透性較低、致病菌較少，CRP、TREM-1、oncostatin M與MMP-9等發炎指標也較低，支持以微生物組為基礎的飲食預防試驗。

gastro.title: Fecal Microbiota Transplantation for Symptom Improvement in Patients With Irritable Bowel Syndrome: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
gastro.title_zh: 糞菌移植改善腸躁症症狀：隨機試驗系統性回顧與統合分析
gastro.abstract: This updated meta-analysis of 13 RCTs (693 IBS patients) found that FMT may reduce symptoms at 12 weeks versus placebo in intention-to-treat analysis (RR of no improvement 0.72, 95% CI 0.50–1.03; very low certainty) and was significant per protocol (RR 0.67). Benefit was seen with single-dose FMT (RR 0.62) and Rome IV-diagnosed IBS (RR 0.38); adverse events did not differ. Results warrant cautious interpretation.
gastro.abstract_zh: 更新版統合分析納入13項RCT共693名腸躁症病人：意向治療分析顯示糞菌移植12週時可能改善症狀（未改善RR 0.72，95% CI 0.50–1.03，證據確定性極低），依計畫書分析達顯著（RR 0.67）；單次移植（RR 0.62）及Rome IV診斷者（RR 0.38）效果較明顯，不良事件無差異，結果需謹慎解讀。

gastro.title: Nonadvanced Adenoma Number and Size as Predictors of Metachronous Advanced Colorectal Neoplasm: Implications for Surveillance Guidelines.
gastro.title_zh: 非進階腺瘤的數目與大小預測後續進階大腸腫瘤：對大腸鏡追蹤指引的啟示
gastro.abstract: Among 16,870 adults aged 50–75 with at least two colonoscopies (median follow-up 5.3 years), 5-year cumulative incidence of advanced colorectal neoplasm was 1.3% with no adenoma, 4.0% with 1–2, 5.3% with 3–4 and 10.1% with 5–10 nonadvanced adenomas (HR 1.64, 2.75 and 5.21). Having at least one small 6–9 mm adenoma raised risk within each count stratum (8.1% vs 3.0% for 3–4 adenomas), so number and size should both guide surveillance intervals.
gastro.abstract_zh: 16,870名50–75歲、接受至少2次大腸鏡者（中位追蹤5.3年）：無腺瘤、1–2顆、3–4顆、5–10顆非進階腺瘤的5年進階腫瘤累積發生率分別為1.3%、4.0%、5.3%、10.1%（HR 1.64、2.75、5.21）。同數目下若有至少1顆6–9 mm腺瘤風險更高（3–4顆者8.1%對3.0%），追蹤間隔應同時考量腺瘤數目與大小。

hepato.title: Autoimmune hepatitis and primary biliary cholangitis are among a subset of autoimmune diseases defined by profound co-prevalence and genetic risk association with the IL12 pathway.
hepato.title_zh: 自體免疫肝炎與原發性膽道膽管炎屬於IL12路徑相關的自體免疫疾病亞群
hepato.abstract: Across 27 diseases, a rare variant upstream of IL12A markedly increased risk of autoimmune hepatitis (OR 2.98), primary biliary cholangitis (OR 2.80), systemic sclerosis, Sjogren's disease, lupus and multiple sclerosis, with a 6-fold lifetime risk in homozygotes. Variants in IL12A and IL12RB2 consistently modified risk across these six diseases while IL23 signaling was not involved, and five of the six strongly co-occurred, suggesting shared etiology and potentially shared targeted therapy.
hepato.abstract_zh: 分析27種疾病發現IL12A上游一個罕見變異大幅增加自體免疫肝炎（OR 2.98）、原發性膽道膽管炎（OR 2.80）、硬皮症、乾燥症、紅斑性狼瘡與多發性硬化的風險，同型合子終身風險達6倍；IL12A與IL12RB2變異在六種疾病中一致影響風險，IL23路徑則無關，且其中五種高度共病，暗示共同病因並可能對相同標靶治療有反應。

hepato.title: Upholding telomeres prevents hepatic stellate cell transdifferentiation and liver fibrogenesis.
hepato.title_zh: 維持端粒穩定可阻止肝星狀細胞轉分化與肝纖維化
hepato.abstract: In carbon tetrachloride and bile-duct-ligation mouse models, hepatic stellate cell-specific overexpression of telomerase (TERT) or the shelterin component TPP1 alleviated fibrosis by suppressing stellate cell activation, proliferation and transdifferentiation. Intraperitoneal TELODIN, a peptide that stabilizes TPP1, likewise attenuated fibrogenesis while keeping stellate cells quiescent, identifying telomere maintenance as a therapeutic target in liver fibrosis.
hepato.abstract_zh: 在四氯化碳與膽管結紮小鼠模型中，肝星狀細胞專一性過度表現端粒酶TERT或端粒保護蛋白TPP1，可抑制星狀細胞活化、增生與轉分化而減輕纖維化；腹腔注射可穩定TPP1的胜肽TELODIN同樣能減輕纖維化並維持星狀細胞靜止，顯示端粒維持是肝纖維化的潛在治療標的。

hepato.title: Reciprocal cross-species infection potential of human and domestic cat hepatitis B viruses.
hepato.title_zh: 人類與家貓B型肝炎病毒跨物種感染潛力之雙向評估
hepato.abstract: Human HBV and hepatitis delta virus efficiently infected HepG2 cells expressing cat NTCP and primary cat hepatocytes, whereas domestic cat hepatitis B virus failed to infect human NTCP cells or primary human hepatocytes. Chimeric envelope experiments localized the restriction to residues 16–49 of the cat virus preS1 region, indicating marginal zoonotic risk to humans and supporting domestic cats as a potential immunocompetent model for HBV research.
hepato.abstract_zh: 人類B型肝炎病毒與D型肝炎病毒可有效感染表現貓NTCP的細胞與貓原代肝細胞，但家貓B型肝炎病毒無法感染表現人類NTCP的細胞或人類原代肝細胞；嵌合套膜蛋白實驗顯示限制區位於貓病毒preS1第16–49個胺基酸。結果顯示其對人類的人畜共通風險極低，並支持以家貓作為免疫健全的B肝研究模式動物。

hepato.title: Beyond second-line therapy: Strategic sequencing of systemic treatments in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma.
hepato.title_zh: 超越二線治療：晚期肝細胞癌全身性治療的策略性排序
hepato.abstract: This review integrates phase 2 and 3 trials and real-world data from more than 4000 patients on sequencing after first-line immunotherapy in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma. Tyrosine kinase inhibitors remain active after immune-based combinations with median overall survival around 10–11 months, and preserved liver function consistently determines eligibility and post-progression survival. Conversion therapy and treatment-free strategies after major responses are emerging frontiers.
hepato.abstract_zh: 本回顧整合第2、3期試驗與超過4000名病人的真實世界資料，探討晚期肝細胞癌一線免疫治療後的治療排序。免疫合併治療後使用酪胺酸酶抑制劑仍有療效，中位整體存活約10–11個月；肝功能保留程度一貫決定後續治療資格與惡化後存活。達主要反應後的轉化治療與停藥策略為新興方向。

diabetes.title: Effect of semaglutide on kidney outcomes in the SELECT, FLOW, and SOUL trials: a prespecified pooled analysis.
diabetes.title_zh: Semaglutide對腎臟結果的影響：SELECT、FLOW、SOUL三大試驗預先設定之合併分析
diabetes.abstract: This prespecified participant-level pooled analysis of SELECT, FLOW and SOUL included 30,787 participants with cardio-kidney-metabolic disease followed for 39.5–47.5 months. The primary kidney composite occurred in 973 semaglutide versus 1134 placebo participants (HR 0.84, 95% CI 0.77–0.91), and the narrower composite excluding cardiovascular death in 347 versus 416 (HR 0.80). Safety was similar between groups and serious adverse events were numerically lower with semaglutide.
diabetes.abstract_zh: SELECT、SOUL與FLOW三項試驗的預先設定個體資料合併分析納入30,787名心腎代謝疾病患者，追蹤39.5至47.5個月。主要腎臟複合終點semaglutide組973件、安慰劑組1134件（HR 0.84，95% CI 0.77–0.91）；排除心血管死亡的次要複合終點347對416件（HR 0.80）。安全性相當，嚴重不良事件在semaglutide組數值上更低。

diabetes.title: Predictors of Type 2 Diabetes Remission and Relapse After Metabolic-Bariatric Surgery or Medical-Lifestyle Therapy in the ARMMS-T2D Study.
diabetes.title_zh: 代謝手術或藥物生活型態治療後第2型糖尿病緩解與復發的預測因子（ARMMS-T2D）
diabetes.abstract: In ARMMS-T2D, 262 patients with type 2 diabetes were randomized to metabolic-bariatric surgery (n=166) or intensive medical-lifestyle management (n=96) and followed for a median 11 years. Diabetes remission occurred in 58% after surgery versus 3% with medical management. Shorter diabetes duration, no insulin use and greater 1-year weight loss predicted remission, while longer duration and more glucose-lowering drug classes predicted relapse.
diabetes.abstract_zh: ARMMS-T2D研究將262名第2型糖尿病病人隨機分配至代謝手術（166人）或密集藥物生活型態治療（96人），中位追蹤11年。手術組58%達糖尿病緩解，藥物組僅3%。糖尿病病程較短、未使用胰島素、一年內減重較多者較易緩解；病程較長與使用較多類降糖藥物者則較易復發。

diabetes.title: Efficacy and safety of once-weekly semaglutide 2·4 mg in Chinese adults with overweight or obesity (STEP 12): a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicentre, phase 3b trial.
diabetes.title_zh: 每週一次semaglutide 2.4 mg用於華人過重或肥胖成人的療效與安全性（STEP 12，含台灣試驗中心）
diabetes.abstract: STEP 12 randomized 242 adults at 19 sites in mainland China and Taiwan with BMI 24–<28 plus a weight-related comorbidity or BMI 28–<30 to once-weekly semaglutide 2.4 mg or placebo for 44 weeks. Body weight fell 12.1% versus 2.2% (treatment difference −9.9 percentage points, P<0.0001), and 80.5% versus 24.4% achieved at least 5% weight loss (OR 14.8). Gastrointestinal disorders were the most common adverse events.
diabetes.abstract_zh: STEP 12試驗於中國大陸與台灣19個中心納入242名BMI 24–<28併有體重相關共病或BMI 28–<30的成人，隨機接受每週一次semaglutide 2.4 mg或安慰劑共44週。體重下降12.1%對2.2%（治療差異−9.9個百分點，P<0.0001），達減重5%以上者80.5%對24.4%（OR 14.8）。最常見不良事件為腸胃道症狀。

ckd.title: Safety outcomes of semaglutide by chronic kidney disease severity in the FLOW trial.
ckd.title_zh: FLOW試驗中semaglutide依腎功能分層之安全性結果
ckd.abstract: This prespecified secondary analysis of FLOW assessed safety by baseline eGFR among 3533 participants with type 2 diabetes and CKD. Serious adverse events were less frequent with semaglutide than placebo across eGFR subgroups (45.1% vs 50.4% at eGFR ≥60; 56.4% vs 60.4% below 30). Discontinuations rose at lower eGFR in both groups, and gastrointestinal discontinuations were more common with semaglutide (4.5% vs 1.1%), with no unexpected safety signals.
ckd.abstract_zh: FLOW試驗預先設定的次要分析依基線eGFR評估3533名第2型糖尿病合併慢性腎病患者的安全性。各eGFR分層中semaglutide組嚴重不良事件均少於安慰劑（eGFR≥60：45.1%對50.4%；<30：56.4%對60.4%）。eGFR愈低兩組停藥率皆升高，因腸胃道症狀停藥在semaglutide組較多（4.5%對1.1%），未發現非預期安全性疑慮。

ckd.title: Initiation of Apixaban Versus Warfarin in Patients With Kidney Failure on Hemodialysis With Newly Diagnosed Atrial Fibrillation: A Target Trial Emulation.
ckd.title_zh: 血液透析病人新診斷心房顫動起始apixaban與warfarin之目標試驗模擬
ckd.abstract: Using US Renal Data System data for 2014–2019, this target trial emulation matched 3978 hemodialysis patients with newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation starting apixaban with 3978 starting warfarin. In intention-to-treat analyses apixaban was associated with 34% lower ischemic stroke (HR 0.66, P=0.02) and 28% lower clinically important bleeding (HR 0.72, P<0.001), with no difference in all-cause mortality and consistent results in patients with CHA2DS2-VASc ≥2.
ckd.abstract_zh: 運用美國腎臟資料系統2014至2019年資料的目標試驗模擬，將3978名新診斷心房顫動並起始apixaban的透析病人與3978名起始warfarin者配對。意向治療分析顯示apixaban組缺血性腦中風風險低34%（HR 0.66，P=0.02）、臨床重要出血低28%（HR 0.72，P<0.001），全因死亡率無差異，CHA2DS2-VASc≥2者結果一致。

ckd.title: Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists and Multi-hormone Receptor Modulators for Kidney Protection in Nondiabetic Kidney Disease.
ckd.title_zh: GLP-1受體促效劑與多重荷爾蒙受體調節劑在非糖尿病腎病的腎臟保護
ckd.abstract: This review examines how GLP-1 receptor agonists and newer multi-hormone receptor modulators targeting GIP, glucagon and amylin may protect the kidney in people without diabetes. Direct mechanisms include natriuresis via NHE-3 inhibition, modulation of glomerular hemodynamics and reduced renal inflammation, independent of glucose lowering; indirect routes include weight loss, blood pressure reduction and improved heart failure. Current evidence rests on secondary kidney endpoints from phase 3 obesity and cardiovascular trials, with dedicated outcome studies under way.
ckd.abstract_zh: 本回顧探討GLP-1受體促效劑及針對GIP、升糖素、胰島澱粉素的多重荷爾蒙受體調節劑如何保護非糖尿病族群的腎臟。直接機轉包括抑制NHE-3促進鈉排出、調節腎小球血流動力學與減少腎臟發炎，與降血糖無關；間接機轉則來自減重、降血壓與改善心衰竭。目前證據主要來自第3期肥胖與心血管試驗的次要腎臟終點，專門的腎臟結果試驗正在進行。

taiwan_news.title: 健保10月起擴大癌藥與罕病用藥給付：食道癌免疫治療納保，約2,600名癌友受惠
taiwan_news.summary: 健保署10月1日起新增tislelizumab用於食道鱗狀細胞癌一線免疫治療、pembrolizumab擴至頭頸癌一線、axicabtagene CAR-T治療復發淋巴瘤等，預估2,600名癌友受惠、藥費約19.76億元；罕病PNH新藥pegcetacoplan與法布瑞氏症口服藥年齡下修至12歲同步納保。

taiwan_news.title: 台灣消除C肝成果登上《The Lancet》：診斷率92.4%、治療率92.7%，提前達WHO 2030目標
taiwan_news.summary: 衛福部石崇良部長等人投書《The Lancet》分享台灣C肝消除經驗：截至2025年12月，慢性C肝診斷率92.4%、已診斷者治療率92.7%，均超越WHO 2030年目標（90%／80%）；B、C肝篩檢已擴大至39–79歲，累計逾786萬人受檢，洗腎、美沙冬與HIV族群治療率達95%。

taiwan_news.title: 屏東新增本土登革熱病例，今年本土已13例：發燒合併腹瀉、肌肉痛別只當腸胃炎
taiwan_news.summary: 疾管署10月8日公布屏東市40多歲女性確診第4型登革熱，10月初出現發燒、頭痛、肌肉痛及腹瀉，無出國史。今年累計188例，本土13例（高雄10、彰化2、屏東1）、境外175例。疾管署提醒落實「巡、倒、清、刷」，發燒合併眼窩痛、關節痛或出疹應速就醫並告知活動史。

taiwan_news.title: 兩年前大腸鏡正常卻便血數月：20多歲護理師揪出藏在「休士頓瓣」死角的息肉
taiwan_news.summary: 大腸直腸外科陳威佑醫師分享，20多歲女性護理師2年前大腸鏡正常，近月反覆少量血便，再檢查發現距肛門10公分內、大於0.5公分的血管豐富息肉，藏在直腸第一道休士頓瓣後方的視覺死角。醫師提醒：持續血便即使曾做過大腸鏡也應再檢查，別自認是痔瘡。

taiwan_news.title: 八旬翁誤吞1公分牙套卡在小腸憩室2個月，馬偕以單氣囊小腸鏡15分鐘免開刀取出
taiwan_news.summary: 台北馬偕胃腸科廖竟妤醫師指出，80多歲男性出國時隨食物吞下約1公分臼齒牙套，等待逾2個月未排出，電腦斷層發現卡在小腸憩室；團隊以單氣囊小腸鏡搭配X光透視與取物網，約15分鐘取出，住院觀察1天出院。章振旺主任提醒：長者吞嚥協調與口腔感覺退化易誤吞異物，尖銳物、鈕扣電池、磁鐵應儘速就醫。

nejm.title: Phase 2 Trial of Icotrokinra for Patients with Ulcerative Colitis.
nejm.title_zh: 口服Icotrokinra治療潰瘍性結腸炎之第二期試驗
nejm.abstract: In this phase 2b, double-blind, randomized trial (ANTHEM-UC), 252 adults with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis received oral icotrokinra, an IL-23 receptor-blocking peptide, at 400 mg, 200 mg, or 100 mg daily or placebo. Clinical response at week 12 was 63%, 58%, and 55% versus 27% with placebo (P<0.001 for all). Clinical remission with 400 mg was 30% vs 11%. Serious adverse events were infrequent. Oral icotrokinra was effective at all doses.
nejm.abstract_zh: ANTHEM-UC第2b期雙盲隨機試驗納入252名中重度活動性潰瘍性結腸炎成人，每日口服IL-23受體阻斷胜肽icotrokinra 400、200、100 mg或安慰劑。第12週臨床反應率分別為63%、58%、55%，安慰劑組27%（皆P<0.001）；400 mg組臨床緩解率30%對11%。嚴重不良事件少見，口服icotrokinra各劑量均有效。

nejm.title: Continuous Glucose Monitoring in Non-Insulin-Treated Type 2 Diabetes.
nejm.title_zh: 連續血糖監測用於未使用胰島素之第2型糖尿病
nejm.abstract: In the 26-week CONNECT trial at 22 US primary care practices, 283 adults with type 2 diabetes not using insulin were randomized to continuous glucose monitoring (n=145) or routine care (n=138). Glycated hemoglobin fell from 8.8% to 7.2% with CGM versus 8.7% to 8.0% with routine care (adjusted difference -0.9 percentage points; P<0.001). Time in range 70-180 mg/dL was 21 percentage points higher with CGM, with no severe hypoglycemia. CGM improved glycemic control in primary care.
nejm.abstract_zh: CONNECT試驗於美國22家基層診所，將283名未使用胰島素的第2型糖尿病成人隨機分配至連續血糖監測（CGM，145人）或常規照護（138人），追蹤26週。糖化血色素CGM組由8.8%降至7.2%，常規組由8.7%降至8.0%（校正差異−0.9個百分點，P<0.001）；血糖在70–180 mg/dL範圍內時間高出21個百分點，無嚴重低血糖。CGM可改善基層血糖控制。

nejm.title: Ponatinib-Blinatumomab or Imatinib-Chemotherapy for Adult Ph-Positive ALL.
nejm.title_zh: Ponatinib併用Blinatumomab對比Imatinib併化療治療成人Ph陽性急性淋巴性白血病
nejm.abstract: In the phase 3 GIMEMA ALL2820 trial, 236 adults with Philadelphia-positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia (median age 55) were randomized 2:1 to frontline chemotherapy-free ponatinib plus blinatumomab or imatinib plus chemotherapy. At median follow-up of 23.7 months, 24-month event-free survival was 86% versus 67% (P<0.001); MRD-negative survival was 68% vs 42%, and cumulative relapse 5% vs 13%. Only 19% of intervention patients underwent transplantation. The targeted immunotherapy approach was superior.
nejm.abstract_zh: GIMEMA ALL2820第三期試驗將236名成人Ph陽性急性淋巴性白血病（中位年齡55歲）以2:1隨機分配至免化療的ponatinib併blinatumomab或imatinib併化療作為一線治療。中位追蹤23.7個月，24個月無事件存活率86%對67%（P<0.001），微量殘存病灶陰性存活68%對42%，累積復發率5%對13%，介入組僅19%接受移植。標靶免疫治療策略顯著優於傳統組合。

lancet.title: Retatrutide in adults with obesity and type 2 diabetes (TRIUMPH-2): a double-blind, parallel-group, randomised, placebo-controlled, phase 3 trial.
lancet.title_zh: Retatrutide治療肥胖合併第2型糖尿病成人（TRIUMPH-2）：第三期隨機安慰劑對照試驗
lancet.abstract: TRIUMPH-2, a double-blind phase 3 trial at 92 centres in eight countries, randomized 1152 adults with BMI ≥27 kg/m² and type 2 diabetes to once-weekly retatrutide (GIP/GLP-1/glucagon triple agonist) 4, 9, or 12 mg or placebo. At week 80, mean weight change was -11.9%, -16.8%, -18.8% versus -5.1% with placebo (all p<0.0001). Gastrointestinal events were most common; discontinuation for adverse events was 12% and 8% at 9 and 12 mg. Retatrutide produced substantial weight loss with improved glycaemia.
lancet.abstract_zh: TRIUMPH-2為8國92中心雙盲第三期試驗，將1152名BMI≥27且有第2型糖尿病的成人隨機分配至每週一次retatrutide（GIP/GLP-1/升糖素三重促效劑）4、9、12 mg或安慰劑。第80週平均體重變化分別為−11.9%、−16.8%、−18.8%，安慰劑組−5.1%（皆p<0.0001）。腸胃道不良事件最常見，9與12 mg組因不良事件停藥率為12%及8%。Retatrutide可大幅減重並改善血糖。

lancet.title: Radiotherapy versus observation following surgical resection of WHO grade 2 atypical meningioma (ROAM/EORTC-1308): an international, multicentre, open-label, phase 3, randomised controlled trial.
lancet.title_zh: WHO第2級非典型腦膜瘤全切除後放射治療對比觀察（ROAM/EORTC-1308）：國際多中心第三期隨機試驗
lancet.abstract: ROAM/EORTC-1308, an open-label phase 3 trial at 58 centres in 11 countries, randomized 157 patients with completely resected newly diagnosed WHO grade 2 atypical meningioma to adjuvant radiotherapy (60 Gy in 30 fractions) or observation. At median follow-up of 64 months, recurrence occurred in 14% versus 30%; 5-year disease-free survival was 79.9% versus 64.3% (HR 0.51, 95% CI 0.27-0.97; p=0.0396). Grade 2-3 radiation-related serious adverse events occurred in 8%. Adjuvant radiotherapy reduces recurrence and should be considered.
lancet.abstract_zh: ROAM/EORTC-1308為11國58中心開放標籤第三期試驗，將157名新診斷WHO第2級非典型腦膜瘤且完全切除的患者隨機分配至輔助放射治療（60 Gy/30次）或觀察。中位追蹤64個月，復發率14%對30%；5年無病存活率79.9%對64.3%（HR 0.51，95% CI 0.27–0.97，p=0.0396）。放療相關第2–3級嚴重不良事件8%。輔助放療可降低復發，應納入考量。

jama.title: Intraoperative Dobutamine Plus Norepinephrine to Prevent Postoperative Acute Kidney Injury in Septic Shock: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
jama.title_zh: 術中併用Dobutamine與Norepinephrine預防敗血性休克患者術後急性腎損傷：隨機臨床試驗
jama.abstract: Open-label randomized trial in 39 Chinese tertiary hospitals enrolling 584 adults with septic shock undergoing surgical source control. Intraoperative dobutamine (up to 5 µg/kg/min) plus norepinephrine versus norepinephrine alone. New-onset or worsening AKI within 7 postoperative days occurred in 22.8% vs 34.7% (adjusted RR 0.64, 95% CI 0.49-0.83), with fewer stage 2-3 AKI and lower day-1 SOFA scores, but more tachycardia. Adding dobutamine reduced postoperative AKI.
jama.abstract_zh: 中國39家醫院584名接受手術感染源控制的敗血性休克成人，隨機分派術中加用dobutamine或單用norepinephrine。術後7天內新發或惡化急性腎損傷為22.8%對34.7%（校正RR 0.64，95% CI 0.49-0.83），第2-3期AKI亦減少，但心搏過速較多。

jama.title: Effect of Vasopressin Initiation Threshold on Septic Shock Mortality: The VASSPR Cluster Crossover Randomized Strategy Trial.
jama.title_zh: Vasopressin啟用閾值對敗血性休克死亡率的影響：VASSPR群集交叉隨機策略試驗
jama.abstract: Pragmatic cluster-crossover trial at 13 hospitals in Idaho and Utah including 3959 adults with septic shock. Hospitals alternated monthly between initiating fixed-dose vasopressin at 0.1 versus 0.4 µg/kg/min norepinephrine-equivalent. The lower threshold increased vasopressin use (68.0% vs 42.7% among eligible patients) but 28-day mortality was 31.8% vs 33.0% (adjusted OR 0.98, 95% CI 0.87-1.06; P=.62); kidney replacement therapy-free days were similar. Earlier vasopressin did not improve survival.
jama.abstract_zh: 美國13家醫院3959名敗血性休克患者的群集交叉試驗，比較在norepinephrine 0.1或0.4 µg/kg/min時啟用vasopressin。低閾值策略提高vasopressin使用率（68.0%對42.7%），但28天死亡率31.8%對33.0%（校正OR 0.98，P=.62），腎替代治療免除天數亦相近，提早使用未改善存活。

jama.title: Isoflurane-Based Inhaled Sedation in Mechanically Ventilated Adults With Acute Hypoxemic Respiratory Failure: The SAVE-ICU Randomized Clinical Trial.
jama.title_zh: Isoflurane吸入性鎮靜用於急性低血氧呼吸衰竭機械通氣成人：SAVE-ICU隨機臨床試驗
jama.abstract: Pragmatic open-label randomized trial in 14 Canadian ICUs enrolling 780 mechanically ventilated adults with acute hypoxemic respiratory failure (73.7% non-COVID). Isoflurane-based inhaled sedation versus usual intravenous sedation. Hospital mortality was 42.5% vs 43.8% (RR 0.98, 95% CI 0.84-1.14; P=.85); ICU-, ventilator- and hospital-free days were similar. The inhaled group received more adjunctive hypoxemia therapies (63.9% vs 55.0%) and had fewer delirium- and coma-free days. Inhaled sedation did not reduce mortality.
jama.abstract_zh: 加拿大14家ICU共780名急性低血氧呼吸衰竭機械通氣成人，隨機接受isoflurane吸入鎮靜或靜脈鎮靜。住院死亡率42.5%對43.8%（RR 0.98，95% CI 0.84-1.14），無呼吸器天數相近；吸入組使用較多低血氧輔助治療（63.9%對55.0%），譫妄/昏迷免除天數較少，未降低死亡率。

jama.title: Cold and Room-Temperature Platelets in Cardiac Surgery: The CHIPS Randomized Clinical Trial.
jama.title_zh: 心臟手術中冷藏血小板與室溫血小板之比較：CHIPS隨機臨床試驗
jama.abstract: Phase 3 adaptive noninferiority trial at 27 US and Australian sites randomizing 989 pediatric and adult cardiac surgery patients with bleeding 2:1 to cold-stored platelets (up to 21 days) or room-temperature platelets (up to 7 days). Cold-stored platelets were noninferior for hemostatic efficacy score at all storage durations (probability >99.9%; mean difference 0.09, 95% CrI -0.06 to 0.23); 24-hour chest tube output was similar. Reexploration was more frequent with cold-stored platelets; other adverse events did not differ.
jama.abstract_zh: 美澳27家中心989名心臟手術出血患者，以2:1隨機輸注冷藏（最長21天）或室溫（最長7天）血小板。冷藏血小板止血效能評分於所有保存期均不劣於室溫血小板（平均差0.09，95% CrI -0.06至0.23），24小時胸管引流量相近，惟再探查率較高，可減少血小板浪費與短缺。

gastro.title: Myofibroblast Derived Transglutaminase 2 Activity is Upregulated in Stricturing Crohn's Disease and its Inhibition Exerts Anti-Fibrotic Properties.
gastro.title_zh: 肌纖維母細胞轉麩醯胺酶2活性在狹窄型克隆氏症上升，抑制後具抗纖維化效果
gastro.abstract: Translational study of transglutaminase 2 (TG2) in intestinal fibrosis. Transglutaminase activity was higher in strictured Crohn's disease tissue than controls, with up to 100% attributable to TG2 and over 95% of human intestinal myofibroblast activity TG2-derived; activity correlated with histologic fibrosis. Selective TG2 inhibition reduced fibronectin and collagen I, III and VI accumulation, and inducible TGM2 knockout prevented fibrosis in two mouse models without changing inflammation.
gastro.abstract_zh: 轉譯研究探討轉麩醯胺酶2（TG2）於腸道纖維化角色。狹窄型克隆氏症組織的TG2活性高於對照組，人類腸道肌纖維母細胞逾95%活性源自TG2，且與組織纖維化程度相關。選擇性抑制TG2可減少膠原堆積；誘導性TGM2基因剔除在兩種小鼠模型中可防止纖維化且不影響發炎，提示纖維化可獨立於發炎進展。

gastro.title: HtpG-High-Expressing Escherichia coli Promotes Fibrosis in Chronic Pancreatitis.
gastro.title_zh: 高表現HtpG的大腸桿菌促進慢性胰臟炎纖維化
gastro.abstract: Multi-omics study of gut dysbiosis in chronic pancreatitis. Metagenomic sequencing identified HtpG-high-expressing Escherichia coli (HHEC) as the dominant microbial signature in patients. Preventing HHEC colonization alleviated disease in mice, while recolonization with patient-derived strain PS718 worsened it. HtpG upregulated macrophage PRMT5, which methylated KLF4 to drive M2 polarization and fibrosis; PRMT5 inhibition, macrophage-specific deletion, or Akkermansia muciniphila each reduced pancreatic fibrosis.
gastro.abstract_zh: 多體學研究分析慢性胰臟炎的腸道菌相失衡，總基因體定序發現病人以高表現HtpG之大腸桿菌（HHEC）為主要菌相特徵。阻斷HHEC定殖可改善小鼠病情，再定殖則惡化。機轉上HtpG上調巨噬細胞PRMT5促進M2極化與纖維化；抑制PRMT5或補充Akkermansia muciniphila皆可減輕胰臟纖維化。

gastro.title: Gut inflammation favors adverse food reactions by disrupting the microbial metabolism of food triggers.
gastro.title_zh: 腸道發炎破壞食物誘發因子的微生物代謝，促成食物不良反應
gastro.abstract: Mouse and translational study of adverse food reactions after gut inflammation. Mice sensitized to dairy or gluten following chemically or hapten-induced colitis developed visceral pain and low-grade inflammation on dietary re-exposure, mediated by colonic mast cells and IgE; gnotobiotic work showed inflammation depleted food-metabolizing colonic bacteria. Supplementing those bacteria or giving mast cell stabilizers attenuated responses. In IBD patients in remission, self-reported food intolerances were common and tracked with microbial depletion.
gastro.abstract_zh: 小鼠與轉譯研究探討腸道發炎後的食物不良反應。小鼠腸炎後對乳製品或麩質致敏，再暴露會出現內臟疼痛與低度發炎，機轉與肥大細胞及IgE相關；發炎會耗竭負責食物代謝的大腸細菌，補充這些細菌或給予肥大細胞穩定劑可減輕反應。緩解期發炎性腸病病人自述食物不耐常見，並與食物代謝菌減少相關。

gastro.title: Targeting Oncomucin-Driven Immunosuppression Improves the Efficacy of K-ras Inhibition in Pancreatic Cancer.
gastro.title_zh: 阻斷致癌黏液素驅動的免疫抑制可提升胰臟癌K-ras抑制療效
gastro.abstract: Preclinical study of oncogenic mucins (MUC4, MUC16, MUC5AC) in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, integrating single-cell RNA sequencing of 34 samples, multiplex immunostaining and mouse models. OncoMUC expression conferred a survival disadvantage (P=.00013); deleting oncoMUC4/16 lowered immune checkpoints VISTA and TIM3 (P<.0001) and increased CD8 T-cell infiltration (P=.0087) via EGFR/UNC5B signaling. Since KRAS inhibition (MRTX1133) upregulated these mucins, adding istradefylline reduced tumor burden (P=.034).
gastro.abstract_zh: 臨床前研究探討致癌黏液素（MUC4、MUC16、MUC5AC）於胰管腺癌的角色，整合34例單細胞RNA定序與小鼠模型。致癌黏液素表現與較差存活相關（P=.00013）；剔除oncoMUC4/16可降低免疫檢查點VISTA與TIM3並增加CD8 T細胞浸潤。由於K-ras抑制劑MRTX1133會上調此類黏液素，合併istradefylline可顯著降低腫瘤負荷（P=.034）。（2026年10月印刷版）

hepato.title: Saroglitazar improves hepatic steatosis and liver enzymes in women with polycystic ovary syndrome and MASLD: A multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled study.
hepato.title_zh: Saroglitazar改善多囊卵巢症候群合併MASLD女性的肝臟脂肪與肝功能：多中心雙盲安慰劑對照試驗
hepato.abstract: Multicenter, randomized, double-blind phase 2A trial in 60 women aged 18-45 with polycystic ovary syndrome and MASLD, assigned 1:1 to saroglitazar 4 mg or placebo for 24 weeks. Relative hepatic fat content on MRI-PDFF fell by 14.81% with saroglitazar versus a 1.96% rise with placebo (p=0.041), and 36.0% versus 8.7% achieved at least 30% fat reduction (p=0.025). Aminotransferases, lipids and FAST score also improved; adverse events were comparable and none serious.
hepato.abstract_zh: 多中心隨機雙盲第二期試驗，收納60名18–45歲多囊卵巢症候群合併MASLD女性，1:1分派saroglitazar 4 mg或安慰劑治療24週。MRI-PDFF肝脂肪相對變化為−14.81%對比安慰劑+1.96%（p=0.041）；達到脂肪下降≥30%者為36.0%對8.7%（p=0.025）。肝酵素、血脂與FAST分數亦改善，不良事件相當且無嚴重事件。

hepato.title: Adjuvant pegylated interferon-alpha after nucleos(t)ide analog withdrawal drives a temporally coordinated expansion of regulatory B cells and contraction of HBV-specific T cells.
hepato.title_zh: 核苷類似物停藥後輔助PEG-IFNα誘發調節性B細胞擴增與HBV特異性T細胞收縮
hepato.abstract: Immunological substudy of the NUC-B trial in 41 HBeAg-negative chronic hepatitis B patients stopping nucleos(t)ide analogs with or without four months of pegylated interferon-alpha. Using IFN-gamma ELISpot and flow cytometry, broader baseline HBV-specific T-cell responses predicted sustained off-treatment viral control and fewer flares. PEG-IFNa transiently reduced HBV-specific T cells for over a month while IL-10-producing regulatory B cells expanded more than 5-fold, inversely correlating with T-cell frequencies and tracking with hepatic flares.
hepato.abstract_zh: NUC-B試驗免疫學子研究，納入41名HBeAg陰性慢性B型肝炎停用核苷類似物（加或不加4個月PEG-IFNα）患者。基線HBV特異性T細胞反應越廣，停藥後病毒控制越佳、肝炎發作越少。PEG-IFNα使HBV特異性T細胞暫時下降逾1個月，同時分泌IL-10的調節性B細胞擴增逾5倍，與肝炎發作同步。

hepato.title: The rise of transplant oncology in primary liver cancer and metastatic disease.
hepato.title_zh: 移植腫瘤學在原發性肝癌與轉移性肝病的興起
hepato.abstract: Narrative review synthesizing clinical series, registries and experimental protocols on liver transplantation for malignancy, covering hepatocellular carcinoma, colorectal and neuroendocrine liver metastases, and intrahepatic and perihilar cholangiocarcinoma. It examines selection criteria, locoregional and systemic downstaging, strategies to expand the donor pool, and oncology-informed immunosuppression. Reported studies show improved survival and lower recurrence when stringent selection and multimodal therapy are applied, supporting transplantation beyond traditional indications pending prospective trials.
hepato.abstract_zh: 本綜述整合臨床系列、登錄資料與實驗性方案，評估肝移植用於惡性腫瘤，涵蓋肝細胞癌、大腸直腸癌與神經內分泌腫瘤肝轉移，以及膽管癌。內容包括病人選擇標準、局部與全身治療降期、擴增捐贈器官來源策略及免疫抑制調整。文獻顯示嚴格選擇加上多模式治療可提升存活並降低復發，支持在傳統適應症之外謹慎擴大應用。（2026年10月印刷版）

hepato.title: Unraveling the tapestry: Lessons from multi-omics and spatial biology in hepatocellular cancer.
hepato.title_zh: 多體學與空間生物學在肝細胞癌的啟示
hepato.abstract: Review of multi-omics and spatial technologies in hepatocellular carcinoma, covering spatial transcriptomics, proteomics, genomics, epigenomics and metabolomics. It shows how profiling within intact tissue architecture resolves the invasive margin, macrophage and fibroblast niches, and immune-evasion barriers that bulk or single-cell analyses miss, uncovering ligand-receptor circuits underlying treatment resistance. The authors outline prognostic and predictive biomarkers and how spatial signatures could guide risk stratification, treatment selection and trial design.
hepato.abstract_zh: 本綜述整理肝細胞癌的多體學與空間生物學技術，包括空間轉錄體、蛋白體、基因體與代謝體分析。於完整組織結構中進行分子定位，可解析侵襲邊緣、巨噬細胞微棲地及免疫逃脫屏障，揭露抗藥機轉。作者並歸納預後與預測生物標記，說明空間特徵如何用於風險分層、治療選擇與臨床試驗設計。（2026年10月印刷版）

diabetes.title: Efficacy and safety of HRS-7535, a novel oral small-molecule glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist, in participants with type 2 diabetes mellitus inadequately controlled by metformin and sodium-glucose co-transporter 2 inhibitors: a multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group Phase II trial.
diabetes.title_zh: 新型口服小分子GLP-1受體促效劑HRS-7535用於metformin合併SGLT2抑制劑控制不佳之第2型糖尿病：第II期試驗
diabetes.abstract: Multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase II trial in 155 Chinese adults with type 2 diabetes (mean HbA1c 8.5%) uncontrolled on metformin plus SGLT2 inhibitor, randomised to oral HRS-7535 30 mg, 60 mg, or placebo once daily for 16 weeks. HbA1c fell by 1.5% and 1.8% versus 0.4% with placebo (p<0.0001); 66% on 60 mg reached HbA1c <7.0% versus 9.8%. Weight loss was 2.4% vs 0.7%. Mostly mild gastrointestinal adverse events; no severe hypoglycaemia.
diabetes.abstract_zh: 多中心隨機雙盲安慰劑對照第II期試驗納入155位metformin合併SGLT2i控制不佳的第2型糖尿病患者，每日口服HRS-7535 30 mg、60 mg或安慰劑16週。HbA1c分別下降1.5%、1.8%，安慰劑組僅0.4%（p<0.0001）；60 mg組66%達HbA1c<7.0%（安慰劑9.8%），體重減輕2.4%。不良事件以輕中度腸胃症狀為主，無嚴重低血糖。

diabetes.title: Efficacy and safety of low-dose IL-2 in people with newly diagnosed type 1 diabetes (DIABIL-2): a double-blind, multicentre, randomised, placebo-controlled, phase 2b trial.
diabetes.title_zh: 低劑量IL-2用於新診斷第1型糖尿病（DIABIL-2）：雙盲多中心隨機安慰劑對照第2b期試驗
diabetes.abstract: Double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 2b trial at 19 European centres enrolled 141 participants aged 6-35 years with type 1 diabetes diagnosed within 3 months, randomised to low-dose subcutaneous IL-2 (once per 2 weeks or weekly) or placebo for 12 months. The primary endpoint, change in mixed-meal C-peptide AUC at month 12, did not differ (geometric mean ratio 1.06, 95% CI 0.56-2.01; p=0.85) despite marked Treg expansion. IL-2 was well tolerated; serious adverse events were 10% vs 20%.
diabetes.abstract_zh: 歐洲19中心雙盲安慰劑對照第2b期試驗，納入141位6–35歲、診斷3個月內的第1型糖尿病患者，隨機接受低劑量皮下IL-2或安慰劑12個月。主要終點12個月混合餐C-peptide AUC無顯著差異（幾何平均比1.06，95% CI 0.56–2.01；p=0.85），儘管調節性T細胞明顯擴增。耐受性良好，嚴重不良事件10%對20%。

diabetes.title: suPAR Identifies Treatment-Resistant Inflammatory Risk Beyond hs-CRP in Type 2 Diabetes With Coronary Artery Disease: An Ancillary Analysis of BARI 2D.
diabetes.title_zh: suPAR可辨識第2型糖尿病合併冠狀動脈疾病患者超越hs-CRP的治療抗性發炎風險：BARI 2D輔助分析
diabetes.abstract: Ancillary analysis of the BARI 2D randomised trial measured plasma suPAR and hs-CRP at baseline (n=2,277) and 1 year (n=1,978) in patients with type 2 diabetes and coronary artery disease. Over 1 year, suPAR was unchanged by diabetes or revascularisation strategy, while hs-CRP fell (2.07 to 1.30 mg/L). suPAR independently predicted death, myocardial infarction, or stroke (HR 1.40 per SD, 95% CI 1.27-1.55) after hs-CRP adjustment; joint classification showed a threefold event-rate gradient (7.1% to 21.6%).
diabetes.abstract_zh: BARI 2D隨機試驗輔助分析，於2,277位第2型糖尿病合併冠狀動脈疾病患者測量基線及1年血漿suPAR與hs-CRP。1年後suPAR不受降糖或血管重建策略影響，hs-CRP則由2.07降至1.30 mg/L。suPAR獨立預測死亡、心肌梗塞或中風（每SD HR 1.40，95% CI 1.27–1.55）；聯合分類顯示事件率三倍梯度（7.1%至21.6%）。

ckd.title: A Microsimulation of Eligibility for Cardiorenal Combination Treatment and Potential Deaths Averted.
ckd.title_zh: 心腎聯合治療適用性與潛在可避免死亡之微觀模擬研究
ckd.abstract: Microsimulation using NHANES 2007-2020 data (8,152 US adults; 15% diabetes, 14% CKD, 5% DKD) assessed eligibility for RASi, SGLT2i, GLP-1RA and nsMRA combinations under 73 guideline recommendations. Only 1% received SGLT2i or GLP-1RA and none nsMRA. RASi+SGLT2i eligibility was 15% overall (DKD 84%); triple therapy 11% (DKD 83%); quadruple 4% (DKD 40%). Triple therapy was projected to avert twice as many all-cause and cardiovascular deaths as dual therapy, indicating large untapped cardiorenal protection.
ckd.abstract_zh: 以NHANES 8,152名美國成人微觀模擬心腎保護聯合治療適用性：RASi+SGLT2i雙療法適用率15%（糖尿病腎病84%），三療法11%，四療法4%；但實際SGLT2i與GLP-1RA使用率僅1%。三療法預估可避免死亡為雙療法2倍，顯示治療落差巨大。

ckd.title: Association of Life's Essential 8 with Risk of End-Stage Kidney Disease in the United Kingdom Biobank Study.
ckd.title_zh: Life's Essential 8心血管健康指標與末期腎病風險：英國生物銀行研究
ckd.abstract: Prospective UK Biobank cohort of 276,494 adults (mean age 56) followed for a median 14.1 years, with 455 incident ESKD events. Each 10-point decrement in Life's Essential 8 cardiovascular health score was associated with 47% higher ESKD risk (HR 1.47; 95% CI 1.34-1.60). Moderate LE8 carried 2.1-fold and low LE8 5.6-fold higher risk versus high LE8, with blood pressure and glucose contributing the largest population-attributable fractions, supporting LE8-guided prevention.
ckd.abstract_zh: 英國生物銀行276,494人前瞻追蹤中位數14.1年，455人發生末期腎病。LE8心血管健康分數每降10分，ESKD風險增47%（HR 1.47）；中等LE8風險為高分組2.1倍，低分組達5.6倍。血壓與血糖為最大人群歸因分率，支持以LE8引導腎病預防。

ckd.title: Technology-Supported Solutions to Improve Guideline-Informed Care for Kidney Disease: Conclusions from a Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) Controversies Conference.
ckd.title_zh: 以科技支援解決方案改善腎臟病指引導向照護：KDIGO爭議會議結論
ckd.abstract: Consensus report from the November 2025 KDIGO Controversies Conference on technology-supported solutions for guideline-informed kidney care. It reviews advances in earlier CKD identification, risk stratification for kidney and cardiovascular outcomes, clinical decision support, monitoring and patient self-management, and identifies patient, clinician, system, policy and technology-level barriers. Research priorities include living guidelines, harmonized decision-support integration, evidence on effectiveness and equity, interoperability and scalability, and evaluating sensor-derived biomarkers.
ckd.abstract_zh: KDIGO於2025年11月召開爭議會議，探討科技支援方案如何改善全球仍不理想的腎臟病指引導向照護，涵蓋早期辨識、風險分層、臨床決策支援與病人自我管理，並提出活指引、決策支援整合、互通性與擴展性、公私協力及感測生物標記等研究優先事項。

taiwan_news.topic: 健康幣大腸癌篩檢獎勵
taiwan_news.title: 健康幣上路首日逾20萬人加入 完成大腸癌糞便潛血篩檢可得900枚
taiwan_news.summary: 健康幣10月1日上路，24小時內逾20.7萬人同意加入。完成公費大腸癌糞便潛血檢查可得900枚，陽性者180天內完成大腸鏡再加1350枚，12月起可兌換健康商品。

taiwan_news.title: 2026全球前2%頂尖科學家出爐 肝炎權威廖運範等長庚3醫師列台灣臨床醫師前20名
taiwan_news.summary: 2026全球前2%頂尖科學家榜單公布，長庚3位醫師進入台灣臨床醫師前20名，包括研究B、C型肝炎自然病史與亞太肝炎、肝癌治療指引的中研院院士廖運範；長庚體系共88人上榜。

taiwan_news.title: 今年首例本土傷寒：中部30多歲女性曾吃生魚片、生蠔 疾管署籲食物煮熟、勤洗手
taiwan_news.summary: 疾管署公布今年首例本土傷寒，中部30多歲女性潛伏期曾食用生魚片與生蠔，發燒、嘔吐、腹瀉後反覆發燒住院確診，已康復。今年累計6例（1本土5境外），提醒飲水煮沸、食物熟食、勤洗手。

taiwan_news.title: 一直想上廁所又解不乾淨？醫師：「裡急後重」有8種原因 合併血便、體重減輕應做大腸鏡
taiwan_news.summary: 80歲婦人因痔瘡就診，候診20分鐘跑廁所3次仍解不乾淨，大腸直腸外科醫師何建霖肛診摸到腫瘤。裡急後重常見原因有8種，若合併血便、排便習慣改變、體重減輕或貧血，應儘快做乙狀結腸鏡或大腸鏡。

taiwan_news.topic: 輸入馬鈴薯配醣生物鹼
taiwan_news.title: 輸入馬鈴薯總配醣生物鹼超標遭退運 食藥署：未發芽也適用200 mg/kg限量
taiwan_news.summary: 食藥署邊境查驗發現一批未發芽的輸入馬鈴薯，總配醣生物鹼248 mg/kg，超過200 mg/kg限量，已全數退運、未流入市面；該業者後續抽驗比率提高至20%至50%，為近半年首例。

nejm.title: Obexelimab for the Treatment of IgG4-Related Disease.
nejm.title_zh: Obexelimab 治療 IgG4 相關疾病
nejm.abstract: In this phase 3, double-blind trial (INDIGO), 194 patients with active IgG4-related disease received weekly subcutaneous obexelimab 250 mg or placebo for 52 weeks, with glucocorticoids tapered off by week 8. Obexelimab prolonged time to first flare requiring rescue therapy (hazard ratio 0.44; flares 26.8% vs. 54.6%), increased complete remission (37.1% vs. 19.6%), and lowered cumulative rescue glucocorticoid dose (329.5 vs. 929.8 mg). Serious adverse events occurred in 10.3% vs. 18.6%.
nejm.abstract_zh: 第三期 INDIGO 試驗納入 194 位活動性 IgG4 相關疾病患者，每週皮下注射 obexelimab 250 mg 或安慰劑 52 週。Obexelimab 組需救援治療的復發較少（26.8% 比 54.6%，HR 0.44），完全緩解率較高（37.1% 比 19.6%），類固醇累積劑量也較低。

nejm.title: Atorvastatin, Cardiovascular Events, and Disability-free Survival in Older Adults.
nejm.title_zh: Atorvastatin 與高齡者心血管事件及無失能存活
nejm.abstract: The STAREE trial randomized 9971 community-dwelling Australians aged 70 years or older without cardiovascular disease, diabetes, or dementia to atorvastatin 40 mg daily or placebo. Over a median of 5.9 years, atorvastatin reduced major cardiovascular events (10.9 vs. 15.5 per 1000 person-years; hazard ratio 0.70) but did not improve disability-free survival (hazard ratio 0.94; P=0.25). Serious adverse events occurred in 2.7% of each group; musculoskeletal, hepatobiliary, and diabetes-related events were more common with atorvastatin.
nejm.abstract_zh: STAREE 試驗將 9971 位 70 歲以上、無心血管疾病的澳洲社區長者隨機分派至 atorvastatin 40 mg 或安慰劑，追蹤中位數 5.9 年。主要心血管事件減少（HR 0.70），但無失能存活未改善（HR 0.94）；肌肉骨骼、肝膽及糖尿病相關不良事件較多。

nejm.title: Vasopressors or Fluids in Early Septic Shock.
nejm.title_zh: 早期敗血性休克：升壓劑或輸液
nejm.abstract: ARISE FLUIDS randomized 1000 adults presenting to emergency departments with septic shock to restricted fluids with early vasopressors or to larger fluid volumes with later vasopressors; 963 were analyzed. The vasopressor group received a median 1108 ml less fluid in 24 hours. Median days alive and out of hospital at day 90 were 76 in both groups (difference 0.0; 95% CI, -2.7 to 2.7). Pulmonary edema was less frequent with early vasopressors (0.6% vs. 5.0%).
nejm.abstract_zh: ARISE FLUIDS 試驗將急診敗血性休克成人隨機分派至限制輸液併早期升壓劑，或較大量輸液併較晚升壓劑，共分析 963 人。90 天存活且出院天數中位數兩組皆為 76 天（差異 0.0），早期升壓劑組肺水腫較少（0.6% 比 5.0%）。

lancet.title: Induction and consolidation atezolizumab with stereotactic body radiation therapy versus radiation alone in high-risk, early-stage non-small-cell lung cancer (SWOG/NRG S1914): a multicentre, open-label, superiority, phase 3, randomised controlled trial.
lancet.title_zh: 高風險早期非小細胞肺癌以 atezolizumab 誘導及鞏固治療併立體定位放射治療對比單獨放射治療（SWOG/NRG S1914）：多中心、開放標籤、優越性第三期隨機對照試驗
lancet.abstract: SWOG/NRG S1914 randomized 417 patients with high-risk, inoperable or unresected T1-T3N0M0 non-small-cell lung cancer to stereotactic body radiation therapy with or without up to eight cycles of atezolizumab. Accrual closed for futility at the first interim analysis. With median follow-up of 24.8 months, the overall survival hazard ratio was 1.04 (95% CI 0.69-1.58), and 2-year survival was 82% in both groups. Grade 3 or higher adverse events were 12% versus 3%.
lancet.abstract_zh: SWOG/NRG S1914 試驗將 417 位高風險、無法或拒絕手術的早期非小細胞肺癌患者隨機分派至 SBRT 併或不併 atezolizumab。試驗因無效提前停止收案；總存活 HR 1.04，兩年存活率兩組皆 82%，第 3 級以上不良事件 12% 比 3%。

lancet.title: Oral deucrictibant for on-demand treatment of hereditary angioedema attacks: a phase 3, multicentre, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial.
lancet.title_zh: 口服 deucrictibant 用於遺傳性血管性水腫發作之按需治療：第三期、多中心、隨機、雙盲、安慰劑對照交叉試驗
lancet.abstract: RAPIDe-3, a phase 3 double-blind crossover trial, randomized 134 adolescents and adults with hereditary angioedema to treat two attacks with oral deucrictibant 20 mg or placebo. Among 88 participants with paired treated attacks, median time to onset of symptom relief was 1.28 hours with deucrictibant versus more than 12 hours with placebo (p<0.0001). No treatment-related adverse events were severe or serious, and none led to discontinuation.
lancet.abstract_zh: RAPIDe-3 第三期雙盲交叉試驗納入 134 位遺傳性血管性水腫青少年及成人，以口服 deucrictibant 20 mg 或安慰劑治療兩次發作。88 位配對分析者症狀開始緩解的中位時間為 1.28 小時，安慰劑超過 12 小時（p<0.0001），無嚴重治療相關不良事件。

jama.title: Nicotinamide Riboside for Patients With Early-Stage Parkinson Disease: The NOPARK Randomized Clinical Trial.
jama.title_zh: 菸鹼醯胺核糖苷用於早期巴金森病患者:NOPARK 隨機臨床試驗
jama.abstract: In this Norwegian double-blind phase 3 trial, 410 patients with early Parkinson disease received oral nicotinamide riboside 500 mg twice daily or placebo for 52 weeks. Total MDS-UPDRS score rose 2.45 points with nicotinamide riboside versus a 0.27-point fall with placebo (adjusted difference 2.72; 95% CI, 0.47-4.98; P = .02), favoring placebo. Nonmotor symptom burden also worsened more (difference 4.22 points). Findings do not support it as disease-modifying therapy.
jama.abstract_zh: 挪威第三期雙盲試驗納入410名早期巴金森病患者,口服菸鹼醯胺核糖苷500 mg每日兩次或安慰劑52週。MDS-UPDRS總分校正後差異2.72分(95% CI 0.47-4.98,P=.02),反而安慰劑較佳;非動作症狀亦較差,不支持其作為疾病修飾治療。

jama.title: Iron or Multiple Micronutrient Powder Supplements With Malaria Chemoprevention in Rural Malawian Children: The IRMA Randomized Clinical Trial.
jama.title_zh: 馬拉威鄉村兒童鐵劑或多種微量營養素粉併用瘧疾化學預防:IRMA 隨機臨床試驗
jama.abstract: This trial randomized 2168 six-month-old infants in rural Malawi (71% anemic) to 6 months of iron syrup or iron-containing micronutrient powders with malaria chemoprevention, chemoprevention alone, or placebo. Versus chemoprevention alone, neither iron intervention improved Bayley-III cognitive scores (mean differences -0.52 and -0.85). Iron raised ferritin but did not reduce anemia prevalence and did not increase malaria risk; chemoprevention alone reduced malaria incidence versus placebo.
jama.abstract_zh: 馬拉威鄉村2168名6個月大嬰兒(71%貧血)隨機接受6個月鐵糖漿或含鐵微量營養素粉併瘧疾化學預防、單獨化學預防或安慰劑。兩種補鐵均未改善Bayley-III認知分數(平均差-0.52與-0.85),鐵蛋白上升但貧血盛行率未降,亦未增加瘧疾風險。

jama.title: Amyloid PET Quantitation and Centiloid Thresholds in the Diagnosis of Alzheimer Disease: An Individual Participant Data Meta-Analysis.
jama.title_zh: 類澱粉正子造影定量與 Centiloid 閾值於阿茲海默症診斷:個別受試者資料統合分析
jama.abstract: This individual participant data meta-analysis pooled amyloid PET scans from 49,227 participants in 53 studies across 15 countries. Data-driven gaussian mixture modeling yielded a single positivity cutoff of 18 Centiloids (95% CI, 16-19). A double-cutoff approach gave high confidence for negative scans below 11 and positive scans above 26 Centiloids. Agreement with visual reads was high (Cohen kappa 0.86) at a cutoff of 27, so values of 11-26 warrant cautious interpretation.
jama.abstract_zh: 此個別受試者資料統合分析彙整15國53項研究、49,227人的類澱粉PET。資料驅動法得出陽性閾值為18 Centiloid(95% CI 16-19);雙閾值顯示低於11可判陰性、高於26可判陽性。與目視判讀一致性高(κ 0.86,閾值27),11至26區間應審慎解讀。

jama.title: Smoking Cessation Among Underserved Patients Referred for Lung Cancer Screening: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
jama.title_zh: 轉介肺癌篩檢之醫療弱勢族群的戒菸介入:隨機臨床試驗
jama.abstract: This US trial randomized 3259 medically underserved smokers referred for lung cancer screening to ask-advise-refer usual care, added free pharmacotherapy, added financial incentives up to $600, or added mobile health tool. Biochemically confirmed sustained abstinence through 6 months was 4.3%, 5.1%, 8.8%, and 7.2%, respectively. Financial incentives increased abstinence versus usual care (difference 4.6%; 95% CI, 2.1%-7.0%; P < .001); free pharmacotherapy alone was not superior (difference 0.5%; P = .66).
jama.abstract_zh: 美國試驗將3259名轉介肺癌篩檢的弱勢吸菸者隨機分為常規照護、加免費藥物、再加最高600美元獎勵金、再加行動健康工具四組。6個月經生化確認持續戒菸率為4.3%、5.1%、8.8%、7.2%;獎勵金較常規照護增加4.6%(P<.001),單加免費藥物無效。

gastro.title: Serrated Polyposis Syndrome: A Review and Consensus Statement by the US Multi-Society Task Force on Colorectal Cancer.
gastro.title_zh: 鋸齒狀瘜肉症候群：美國大腸直腸癌多學會工作小組之回顧與共識聲明
gastro.abstract: This US Multi-Society Task Force consensus addresses serrated polyposis syndrome (SPS), the most common yet often unrecognized polyposis syndrome, diagnosed by WHO clinical criteria (size, cumulative number and location of serrated polyps). SPS raises prevalent and incident colorectal cancer risk. Meticulous inspection, colon clearing and frequent surveillance colonoscopy are recommended; surgery is for cancer or endoscopically unmanageable polyp burden. Germline testing is reserved for those meeting criteria for known hereditary syndromes; first-degree relatives should undergo colonoscopic screening.
gastro.abstract_zh: 美國多學會共識：鋸齒狀瘜肉症候群依WHO臨床標準診斷，大腸癌風險上升。建議清除瘜肉並密集大腸鏡追蹤，罹癌或內視鏡無法控制者才手術；一等親應接受大腸鏡篩檢。

gastro.title: Faecalibacterium prausnitzii EXL01 Strain for the Prevention of Multiple-Recurrent Clostridioides difficile Infection.
gastro.title_zh: Faecalibacterium prausnitzii EXL01 菌株用於預防多次復發性困難梭狀桿菌感染
gastro.abstract: In a multicenter, open-label, single-arm phase 1 trial, adults with ≥3 Clostridioides difficile infection episodes received oral Faecalibacterium prausnitzii EXL01 for 8 weeks after vancomycin preconditioning. Six patients were treated with no treatment-related serious adverse events; 5 of 6 (83.3%) were recurrence-free at week 8, comparable to matched FMT cohorts. Engraftment correlated with restored bile acid metabolism and increased butyrate despite limited taxonomic recovery. Controlled trials are ongoing.
gastro.abstract_zh: 第一期單臂試驗：≥3次困難梭狀桿菌感染者口服EXL01菌株8週，6例無治療相關嚴重不良事件，5例（83.3%）第8週未復發，與配對FMT世代相當，膽酸代謝恢復。

gastro.title: Global burden of liver disease: 2026 update.
gastro.abstract: This review updates the global burden of liver disease. Chronic liver disease affects more than 1.5 billion people; cirrhosis is the 12th leading cause of death and, with primary liver cancer, accounts for nearly 2.4 million deaths annually, disproportionately in low- and middle-income countries. Main etiologies are alcohol-associated liver disease, MASLD and chronic HBV/HCV. Africa now has the highest age-standardized mortality from cirrhosis and liver cancer. Integrated prevention, early detection and equitable access to care are urged.
gastro.abstract_zh: 慢性肝病影響全球逾15億人，肝硬化為第12大死因，合併肝癌每年近240萬人死亡。主因為酒精性肝病、MASLD與B、C型肝炎；非洲年齡標準化死亡率最高。

gastro.title: Chronic Pancreatitis: Mechanisms of Inflammation, Pathways of Progression and Emerging Therapeutic Strategies.
gastro.title_zh: 慢性胰臟炎：發炎機轉、疾病進展路徑與新興治療策略
gastro.abstract: This review describes chronic pancreatitis as a progressive fibroinflammatory disease following acinar cell injury, inflammation and fibrosis. Diagnosis usually relies on ductal dilatation or calcification, reflecting advanced disease; early-stage diagnosis remains difficult because validated biomarkers are lacking and histopathology access is limited. Current treatment mainly relieves ductal obstruction endoscopically or surgically. The authors review inflammatory mechanisms, progression pathways, and current and emerging disease-modifying therapies, calling for patient-tailored approaches that limit inflammation and preserve organ function.
gastro.abstract_zh: 慢性胰臟炎為腺泡損傷、發炎至纖維化的進行性疾病，早期診斷因缺乏驗證之生物標記而困難。現行治療以內視鏡或手術解除胰管阻塞為主，本文整理發炎機轉與新興疾病修飾療法。

hepato.title: Efficacy and safety of an 8-week bemnifosbuvir and ruzasvir regimen in chronic hepatitis C: Results from a Phase 2 study.
hepato.title_zh: Bemnifosbuvir 合併 ruzasvir 八週療程治療慢性 C 型肝炎的療效與安全性：第二期試驗結果
hepato.abstract: This single-arm phase 2 study gave bemnifosbuvir 550 mg plus ruzasvir 180 mg once daily for 8 weeks to 275 treatment-naïve patients with chronic HCV of any genotype; 13% had compensated cirrhosis and 27% baseline NS5A resistance-associated substitutions. SVR12 was 98% (210/215) in the adherent per-protocol population, 95% in the efficacy-evaluable population and 90% by intention-to-treat. Five patients relapsed. No drug-related serious adverse events or drug-related discontinuations occurred.
hepato.abstract_zh: 單臂第二期試驗納入275位初治慢性C肝患者（13%代償性肝硬化），每日bemnifosbuvir 550 mg加ruzasvir 180 mg共8週。服藥遵從族群SVR12達98%，意向治療族群90%，5例復發，無藥物相關嚴重不良事件。

hepato.title: An international multicenter analysis of the outcome of pediatric first variceal hemorrhage.
hepato.title_zh: 兒童首次靜脈瘤出血預後的國際多中心分析
hepato.abstract: This international study of 44 centers analyzed 345 children after first variceal hemorrhage. Overall and native-liver survival were significantly higher in portal vein thrombosis and noncirrhotic disease than in biliary atresia and cirrhotic disease (p<.001). Native-liver survival was lower with decompensation, biliary atresia with poor bile flow, sclerotherapy or no endoscopic intervention. Six-week mortality was 4.1% overall, 1.4% in nonhospitalized children, and higher in low-volume than high-volume center clusters (P=.010).
hepato.abstract_zh: 44個國際中心、345位兒童首次靜脈瘤出血的分析顯示，6週死亡率為4.1%，低於成人。肝門靜脈栓塞與非肝硬化疾病的存活優於膽道閉鎖與肝硬化（p<.001）；失代償及硬化劑治療者預後較差，低量能中心死亡率較高。

hepato.title: AASLD EXPO: Liver biopsy.
hepato.title_zh: AASLD 專家實務意見（EXPO）：肝臟切片
hepato.abstract: This AASLD Expert Practice Opinion, based on a targeted literature review and unanimously agreed statements, addresses liver biopsy. It has three major indications: establishing a diagnosis, staging inflammation and/or fibrosis, and enhancing clinical management. Percutaneous biopsy is used in most patients; the transjugular route suits ascites, coagulopathy or HVPG measurement, and endoscopic ultrasound-guided biopsy suits concurrent variceal evaluation or portal pressure measurement. Techniques appear similarly safe and adequate in expert hands; limitations include sampling variability, interobserver differences and complications.
hepato.abstract_zh: AASLD專家意見指出肝切片三大適應症：確立診斷、評估發炎與纖維化分期、輔助臨床處置。多數採經皮途徑；腹水、凝血異常或需測HVPG時採經頸靜脈；內視鏡超音波導引為新進展。各途徑安全性相近。

hepato.title: TESERA: morphologic subtyping and prognostic stratification of hepatocellular carcinoma from H&E whole-slide images.
hepato.title_zh: TESERA：以 H&E 全玻片影像進行肝細胞癌的形態學分型與預後分層
hepato.abstract: TESERA is a computational pathology framework deriving HCC subtypes and a prognostic index from H&E whole-slide images. In TCGA-LIHC, unsupervised clustering yielded TES1 (metabolic pathways, CTNNB1 mutations, favorable) and TES2 (proliferative pathways, TP53 mutations; overall survival HR 4.20). The supervised morphologic index predicted overall survival (HR 3.17) and disease-free survival (HR 2.19), with C-index 0.73, remained independent after multivariable adjustment (HR 2.97), and stratified survival in an independent in-house cohort (HR 2.16).
hepato.abstract_zh: TESERA以H&E全玻片影像運算病理將肝細胞癌分為代謝型TES1（CTNNB1突變、預後佳）與增殖型TES2（TP53突變，總存活HR 4.20）。其形態指數預測總存活HR 3.17、C-index 0.73，並於獨立世代驗證（HR 2.16）。

diabetes.title: Long-term safety of oral orforglipron in Japanese participants with type 2 diabetes (ACHIEVE-J): a multicentre, randomised, open-label, parallel-group phase 3 trial.
diabetes.title_zh: 口服 orforglipron 用於日本第 2 型糖尿病患者之長期安全性（ACHIEVE-J）：多中心、隨機、開放標籤、平行分組第三期試驗
diabetes.category: 口服 GLP-1 受體促效劑
diabetes.abstract: In this open-label phase 3 trial at 40 Japanese sites, 401 adults with type 2 diabetes on diet and exercise alone or one or two oral agents received once-daily orforglipron 3, 12, or 36 mg for 52 weeks. Treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 85%, mostly mild or moderate; discontinuation due to adverse events was 5%, 8%, and 14%, mainly gastrointestinal. Level 2 hypoglycaemia occurred in 2% of the 12 mg and 36 mg groups; no severe hypoglycaemia occurred.
diabetes.abstract_zh: 日本第三期試驗，401位第2型糖尿病成人每日口服orforglipron 3、12或36 mg共52週。85%出現不良事件，多為輕中度；因不良事件停藥率5%、8%、14%，以腸胃道為主，無嚴重低血糖。

diabetes.title: Efficacy of the digital therapeutic glucura combined with CGM in the treatment of type 2 diabetes: a randomised controlled trial over 6 months.
diabetes.title_zh: 數位療法 glucura 合併連續血糖監測治療第 2 型糖尿病之療效：為期 6 個月的隨機對照試驗
diabetes.abstract: This 6-month open-label RCT at 24 German sites randomised 327 adults with non-insulin-treated type 2 diabetes (HbA1c 7.0-11.0%, BMI ≥25) to the digital therapeutic glucura or a control app, both with intermittent CGM. HbA1c fell 0.80 versus 0.30 percentage points (adjusted difference -5 mmol/mol [-0.46 points]; 95% CI -7 to -3 mmol/mol). More participants reached HbA1c <7.0% (55% vs 31%), and weight loss was greater (4.11% vs 1.79%). No device-related serious adverse events occurred.
diabetes.abstract_zh: 德國隨機試驗納入327位未用胰島素的第2型糖尿病成人，皆搭配間歇性CGM。6個月時glucura組HbA1c降0.80、對照組0.30個百分點（差異-0.46）；體重減輕4.11%比1.79%。

diabetes.title: Effects of time-restricted eating on markers of glucose metabolism and regulation in individuals with prediabetes or type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials.
diabetes.title_zh: 限時進食對糖尿病前期或第 2 型糖尿病患者葡萄糖代謝與調節指標之影響：隨機對照試驗的系統性回顧與統合分析
diabetes.abstract: This meta-analysis pooled ten RCTs (599 participants; mean duration 4 months; eating windows 4-10 hours) of time-restricted eating in prediabetes or type 2 diabetes. HbA1c was not significantly reduced overall (-0.30 percentage points; 95% CI -0.63 to 0.02; moderate certainty), though it fell slightly in prediabetes (-0.09 points). Fasting glucose decreased by 0.30 mmol/L and body weight by 1.6 kg. Effects on insulin sensitivity, beta cell function and CGM measures were inconclusive.
diabetes.abstract_zh: 統合10項隨機試驗共599人。限時進食未顯著降低HbA1c（-0.30個百分點，p=0.06），但空腹血糖下降0.30 mmol/L、體重減少1.6公斤；糖尿病前期者HbA1c略降0.09個百分點。

ckd.title: Comparative Cardiovascular Outcomes of Lanthanum Carbonate and Sevelamer in Dialysis.
ckd.title_zh: 透析病人使用碳酸鑭與 sevelamer 之心血管預後比較
ckd.abstract: This target trial emulation using the China Renal Data System compared new users of lanthanum carbonate versus sevelamer among dialysis patients with hyperphosphatemia and no documented prior MACE. In 10,518 propensity-matched patients, 3-year cumulative MACE incidence was 9.5% versus 12.2% (HR 0.79; 95% CI 0.68-0.92; number needed to treat 37). Lanthanum was also associated with lower all-cause mortality (HR 0.83) and cardiovascular mortality (HR 0.72), consistent across sensitivity analyses.
ckd.abstract_zh: 中國腎臟數據系統目標試驗模擬，10,518位配對之高血磷透析病人中，碳酸鑭相較sevelamer的3年MACE為9.5%比12.2%（HR 0.79），全因死亡HR 0.83、心血管死亡HR 0.72。

ckd.title: International Society of Nephrology International Expert Forum: Exploring the Nexus of Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Health.
ckd.title_zh: 國際腎臟醫學會國際專家論壇：探討心血管－腎臟－代謝健康的交會
ckd.abstract: This International Society of Nephrology expert forum report synthesizes multidisciplinary discussions on cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic health, covering risk stratification, lifestyle interventions, guideline-directed medical therapies, emerging late-stage therapeutics, and care delivery models. Participants emphasized early integrated case finding, long-term joint kidney-cardiovascular risk assessment, and timely use of evidence-informed therapies to reduce kidney disease progression, kidney failure, and cardiovascular events. Persistent gaps include therapeutic inertia, fragmented care, and global inequities in access.
ckd.abstract_zh: 國際腎臟醫學會專家論壇報告，彙整CKM風險分層、生活型態介入、指引導向藥物、新興療法與照護模式；強調早期整合性個案發現與腎臟心血管聯合風險評估，並指出治療惰性、照護片段化及可近性不均。

ckd.title: Resistant Hypertension: State of the Art Review.
ckd.title_zh: 頑固型高血壓：最新進展回顧
ckd.abstract: This review notes resistant hypertension affects over 140 million people globally and raises risks of heart failure, stroke, and CKD progression. Ambulatory and home monitoring are central to excluding pseudo-resistance. Treatment centers on lifestyle measures and triple therapy with a renin-angiotensin system blocker, calcium channel blocker, and thiazide-like diuretic, followed by a mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist as fourth-line. Newly FDA-approved aprocitentan and baxdrostat and renal denervation expand options; CKD requires attention to volume status and hyperkalemia risk.
